{{Infobox Enemy |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Black Bokoblin Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Black Bokoblin Model.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |race= [[Bokoblin]] |game= BotW, TotK |other= CoH, AoC, AoI |habitat= |health= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= {{HP|BotW|240}} |TotK= {{HP|TotK|240}} }} |member= |attack= |weapon= |spoils= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= {{Icon List|BotW| * Bokoblin Horn * Bokoblin Fang * Bokoblin Guts }} |TotK= {{Icon List|TotK| * Black Bokoblin Horn * Bokoblin Fang * Bokoblin Guts }} |AoC= {{Icon List|AoC| * Bokoblin Horn * Bokoblin Fang * Bokoblin Guts * Bokoblin Trophy }} }} |exp= |theme= }} '''Black Bokoblins''' are recurring [[Enemy|Enemies]] in the {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Black Bokoblin|Black Bokoblins|Series, BotW, TotK, CoH, AoC, AoI}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} * {{CoH}} * {{AoC}} * {{AoI}} }} }} ==Characteristics== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract|Black Bokoblin}} Black Bokoblins are a stronger variant of [[Bokoblin]], and they are considered to be one of the most dangerous. They are much more resilient and are usually armed with stronger [[Weapon]]s than their common counterparts, including [[Dragonbone Boko Club]]s and [[Dragonbone Boko Bat]]s. Black Bokoblins can be found in [[Monster Stronghold]]s and occasionally on roads, where they may attack passing travelers. Black Bokoblins can also sometimes be found going on hunts while riding [[Horse]]s. Black Bokoblins share an attack pattern with other Bokoblin counterparts. On the ground, Black Bokoblins mainly attack by swinging and slamming their held Weapons. In the event that their Weapons is lost or stolen, they will search for any other available Weapons nearby and use them instead. In some Monster Strongholds, Black Bokoblins may also be found standing on top watch towers, where they may alert other [[Monster]]s to Link's presence by blowing a horn. These Black Bokoblins may also be equipped with [[Bow]]s that they use to snipe intruders with [[Arrow]]s. When defeated, Black Bokoblins may drop [[Bokoblin Fang]]s, [[Bokoblin Horn]]s, or [[Bokoblin Guts]]. ====Drops==== {{Collapsible |header= Drops of Black Bokoblin |collapse= true |content= {{Tabs |- | Normal | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | Bokoblin Guts | 1 | 100 % |- | Bokoblin Fang | 1-2 | 100 % |- | Bokoblin Horn | 1 | 100 % }} |- | FireArrow | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | Fire Arrow x5 | 1-2 | 40 % |- | Bokoblin Fang | 1-2 | 60 % |- | Bokoblin Horn | 1 | 100 % |- | Bokoblin Guts | 1

| 100 % }} }} }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= TotK |type= Enemies |category= Bokoblins |needs= * Detailed information on enemy behavior * Detailed information on the enemy's weaknesses }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Black Bokoblin}} {{Stub|TotK}} Black Bokoblins reappear in {{TotK}}, acting mostly the same as they did in {{BotW}}. They are now capable of wearing backpacks to carry [[Material]]s and wearing [[Rock Armor]] to protect themselves. Black Bokoblins will use a variety of attacks depending on what weapon they have equipped. They are able to ram [[Link]] with their new [[Black Bokoblin Horn]]s. They also swing or spin [[One-Handed Weapon]]s, and they can guard themselves with [[Shield]]s. Black Bokoblins can sometimes be found in [[Monster Outpost]]s and [[Monster Stronghold]]s. In these camps, they can be found guarding [[Treasure Chest]]s, which may contain a [[Weapon]] or [[Gem]]. They sleep during the night and are awake during the day. Sometimes, Black Bokoblins can be seen eating [[Meat]] by their [[Campfire]]s. Sometimes, Black Bokoblins may guard their camps from a small watchtower. Black Bokoblins may be found in camp, or on patrol with [[Blue Boss Bokoblin]]s or [[Black Boss Bokoblin]]s. In these cases, Black Bokoblins will follow the commands of their [[Boss Bokoblin]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{CoH|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|CoH}} [[File:CoH Black Bokoblin Sprite.png|left]] Black Bokoblins appear as enemies in {{CoH}} where they move to the beat of the music. They're stronger than the [[Green Bokoblin]] and [[Red Bokoblin]], but share the same beat pattern as they raise their arms up for one beat before moving on the following beat. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} In {{AoC}}, Black Bokoblins appear as the second strongest type of [[Bokoblin]], first appearing in the [[Scenario]] "[[Calamity Strikes]]." They may drop a [[Bokoblin Fang]], a [[Bokoblin Horn]], or [[Bokoblin Guts]]. At the end of a [[Battle]], a [[Bokoblin Trophy]] will be awarded for each defeated. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Enemies |category= Enemies in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * The Enemy's behavior * The Enemy's weaknesses }} {{Stub|AoI}} Black Bokoblins as they appeared in {{TotK}} are featured in {{AoI}}. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:BotW Black Bokoblin Horse Rider Model.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}A Black Bokoblin riding a Horse File:BotW Master Mode Promotional Screenshot.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Link fighting Blue and Black Bokoblins on the Great Plateau in Master Mode File:BotW Bokoblin Concept Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of a Black Bokoblin File:TotK Black Bokoblin Model 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}A Black Bokoblin with a basket on its back File:TotK Black Bokoblin Model 3.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}A Gloom-Wreathed Black Bokoblin File:TotK Black Bokoblin Model 4.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}A Gloom-Wreathed Black Bokoblin with a basket on its back File:TotK Black Bokoblin Rock Armor Model.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}A Black Bokoblin wearing Rock Armor File:TotK Black Bokoblin Rock Armor Model 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}A Gloom-Wreathed Black Bokoblin wearing Rock Armor File:CoH Black Skull Bokoblin Sprite.png|{{Game Label|{{CoH|-}}}}A Black Skull Bokoblin ==See Also== {{See Also| * Black Skull Bokoblin * Bokoblin * Enemy * Monster }} {{Ref| {{Cite|'''Black Bokoblin'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} {{Cite|Although Bokoblins are generally a nuisance, the Black Bokoblins are among the most dangerous type.
